messages:
sasha_pm: FYI dropping an RFC draft into the doc for embedding dim+normalization migration. Need quick alignment on launch criteria and a conservative rollout plan. link: https://redwood/notes/embed-migrate

maya_ml: skimmed. main concern is reranker compatibility — a dim change breaks downstream models unless we provide a compatibility shim.

jon_platform: +1. We should avoid a hard cutover. Suggest per-customer routing flags and a per-route compatibility mode that projects to the expected dim.

ravi_research: For projection: we can provide two strategies: 1) linear projection matrix (learned or PCA) and 2) zero-pad/trim fallback. Learned projection preserves semantics best but adds compute.

elaine_prod: Customers asked for bigger dims for quality. They expect minimal regression. What acceptance criteria should we commit to in the PRD?

maya_ml: Proposal for acceptance criteria (draft):
- Quality: mean cosine similarity between old and new embeddings on the canonical eval set >= 0.92 for queries that should be semantically equivalent.
- Rerank parity: downstream reranker rank correlation (Kendall tau) drop <= 0.03 on production prompt set.
- Latency: p99 end-to-end call delta <= +8ms for hosted default path; per-customer SLAs may differ.
- Cost: per-token GPU cost delta <= +20% for default serving config.
- No data loss: all customer metadata relevant to vectors preserved.

jon_platform: Add ops acceptance: rollback path tested with canary serving traffic <= 5% for 24h, automated fallback to old model if alerts fire.

ravi_research: Also add embedding-distribution drift checks: KL divergence or wasserstein distance on vector norm distribution within thresholds. If normalization changes from raw to unit-normalized we must measure drift.

sasha_pm: Agree. Can we define concrete alert triggers for the rollout?

maya_ml: Suggested alerts:
- rerank_kendall_drop > 0.04 over 30m window -> auto-fallback
- mean_cosine_similarity < 0.9 on eval probes -> pause rollout
- p99_latency_delta > 12ms for 10m -> rollback to old variant

opsbot: deploy-bot: Canary deployed variant embed-v2 to pool-a with 3% traffic at 2026-02-14T09:23:54Z.

jon_platform: About batching: embed-v2 uses a different sequence-length distribution since dim increased. We must test batching tuning — larger dim increases memory per item and may reduce max batch size. Acceptance tests should include throughput at target QPS with same latency SLO.

ravi_research: On normalization edge cases: some customers rely on L2-normalized vectors in their similarity thresholds. If we change default to unit-normalized, thresholds must be translated. Add migration doc section with formulae: e.g., if v_old was not normalized, provide mapping examples to expected cosine thresholds.

elaine_prod: For customers on Dedicated/Private, we'll offer a migration toggle and a migration window. For Hosted API, we'll provide a gradual opt-in and a compatibility shim for 6 months. Add to PRD.

maya_ml: Draft of migration playbook (short):
1) Pre-launch: generate benchmark probes and reranker testset, run offline sim comparing old/new embeddings (cosine, kendall, recall@k).
2) Canary: 1-5% traffic, projection shim enabled for rerankers, monitor alerts for 24-72h.
3) Staged rollout: 5->25->50->100% with hold times and checkpoints.
4) Post-rollout: 90-day compatibility support, telemetry retention for drift analysis.

jon_platform: Implementation notes: expose endpoint header `X-Embed-Version: auto|v1|v2|compat` so clients can pin. Also add admin route `/v1/embeddings/convert` that projects between dims for offline migration jobs. Example curl: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"from":"v1","to":"v2","vectors":[[...]]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/convert
```

ravi_research: We'll provide projection matrices precomputed per-model. For open models we can provide a default PCA-based projector; customers can upload custom projector if they trained local rerankers.

elaine_prod: Timeline request from sales: a beta for key accounts in 6 weeks, GA in 12 weeks. Is that feasible?

maya_ml: With parallel workstreams (proj matrices, API, canary infra, docs) 12 weeks feels tight but doable if we scope: beta=select customers with simple rerankers, exclude heavy on-prem migrations.

jon_platform: I'll need an eng PRD for infra tasks and an ETA. I'll own canary infra and header flag.

ravi_research: I'll own projector generation and the offline eval harness.

sasha_pm: Action items:
- maya_ml: write formal PRD section with acceptance criteria + migration playbook (due in 3 business days)
- jon_platform: infra PRD for canary flags + convert endpoint (due 5 days)
- ravi_research: run initial PCA vs learned projection experiments and share results (due 7 days)
- elaine_prod: coordinate beta customers and comms (due 7 days)

maya_ml: noted. I'll include exact eval buckets and sample queries so QA can run deterministic checks.

sasha_pm: Thanks all. If anyone has strong objections to thresholds above, speak now. Otherwise I'll drop this into the formal PRD and ping legal for SLA language. :thumbsup:

jon_platform: no objections from infra side.

ravi_research: fine, will surface if any experiment shows major regressions.

elaine_prod: good to go from my side.

opsbot: reminder: Next infra sync Thu 16:00 UTC to review canary dashboards.

sasha_pm: closing thread, will post PRD link when updated.
